cases.title: Wrong password shows a generic error
preconditions: FieldLog is installed from the test build

steps.action: Type the email tecnico1@example.com and the wrong password, tap Sign in
steps.expected: A message says the email or password is not correct

steps.action: Type the unknown email nessuno@example.com and any password, tap Sign in
steps.expected: Exactly the same message as in step 2

cases.expected_result: Both attempts show the same message; nothing reveals whether the email is registered

cases.title: Job logged offline is synced when back online
preconditions: Back-office dashboard open in Chrome as ufficio@example.com

steps.action: Turn on airplane mode on the phone
Tap New job, fill in the test data, add a photo, tap Save
steps.expected: The job appears in the list with a 'waiting to sync' badge

steps.action: Turn off airplane mode and wait one minute

steps.expected: The job is listed with the photo

cases.expected_result: The job saved offline appears on the dashboard within one minute of reconnecting, with its photo

cases.title: Filter jobs by date and technician
preconditions: Test data loaded: 30 jobs by 3 technicians over October

steps.expected: The counter above the list updates

cases.expected_result: Only Tecnico Uno's jobs between 1 and 15 October are listed (8 jobs in the test data)

cases.title: Dashboard usable with the keyboard only
preconditions: Mouse or touchpad not used during the test

steps.action: Press Tab repeatedly from the top of the Jobs page
steps.expected: A clearly visible outline moves through filters, list and buttons in reading order

steps.action: Reach the date filter and set a range with the keyboard only
Open a job with Enter and close it with Esc

cases.expected_result: Every action is possible without a mouse and the focus is always visible

cases.title: Customer signature appears in the PDF
preconditions: A synced job exists for Condominio Aurora

steps.action: On the phone open the job and tap Customer signature
Hand the phone to the customer, let them sign, tap Confirm
On the dashboard open the job and download the PDF

cases.expected_result: The PDF shows the signature in the signature box with date and customer name

defects.description: Sign-in error reveals that an email is not registered ('User not found'), enabling account enumeration (TM-01)
